steps.note: S2.3.4b states that rows 0-1 subtract Ja+Rc, rows 2-5 add J(a+Vx)+R(c+Gx), rows 6-7 restore c,a, so the net change (JV+RG)x is independent of a,c, with the paper's line 744 quote in that role.
S2.3.4c gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, intersections zero/two already zero, and self coefficient one.
S2.3.4d gives central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S2.3.5 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) using forward, inverse, forward schedules and says every auxiliary value is restored.
S2.5.5b reproduces the full table of per-edge orthogonal residuals with dimensions and S2.5.5a states that every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels.
S2.5.5d states that t_X perp t_Y gives <t_X> inside t_Y^perp so edge 2->5 is an inclusion with residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2.
S2.5.5a/c identify center 3->4 (loss h) as the only decreasing edge and S2.5.5e/S2.5.2b give sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N via gate telescoping, and absolute Wm-2N+2L.

S2.5.5f states every nonzero F_2 residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating hence has an orthonormal basis, with the quote carrying the unit-vector argument and the absorption of alternating planes.
S2.5.5g states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.
S2.6.5 gives wt(z+w)=wt(z)+wt(w)-2|supp cap supp| so weight is additive mod 4 when z.w=0, and S2.6.6 gives q_V-q_U=sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x] mod 4.
S2.6.7 states wt(v) is odd, phase i^{eps[v.x]}, and that H diag(1,-1) H = X turns it into aI+bX_v or its inverse.
S2.6.9 states that on k columns each residual vector contributes one factor K_{e,v}^{tensor k} and there are s_c such factors over the network.
S2.6.11 gives zero label frame I, full label C^{tensor m}, C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates; S2.6.12 gives C=iZC^{-1}Z with Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after; S2.6.13 negates the X outputs.
The plan states L/N<1/2 (S2.5.5g, S2.5.2b) and the resulting deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0 with s<Wm (S2.5.6e, S2.5.6c, S2.6.8).
S2.6.14b-d state both deficits exceed 20*2^-50, log m<20, m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta), hence s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50.
S2.8.2 gives the topmost-row rightmost-entry pivot with lower-triangular clearing and S2.8.3 gives repetition on active indices and exactly a ones in Pi.

S2.8.4 only asserts that a fixed odd prime q exists for the finite collection; it never says q avoids every denominator in a finite table of factors or that the triangular factors stay invertible mod q^b (S2.9.2's 'avoiding the denominators' concerns circuit matrices, a different role).
S2.8.5 states a lower triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each by its diagonal unit and a fixed combination of earlier coordinates.
S2.8.7 realizes each one by D_j+=H_i, an interchange, D_j=H_i-D_j with one interchange, and S2.8.8 gives a ones so a interchanges in all.
S2.12.8a gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3}, C_0=128mB^2, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with nu=11 and C_1=20.
S2.12.8c states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf, and S2.12.8b bounds the per-invocation operation count by 24W^3+4s+4W+4<E.
S2.12.8d gives sx+E<=Bx, B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu and A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, and S2.12.8e shows the total depth stays below 128mB^2 d^{nu+3}<=C_0 d^{C_1}.
S2.12.8f gives depth-ell values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus <=2^ell by induction and p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits being exact; S2.12.8g gives epsilon*C_1<1 hence Delta=o(p).
S2.12.10e states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disks are preserved, and truncation changes each component by less than 2^-p giving error below sqrt2 2^-p.

summary: 25 of 26 sub-steps present; only M2 is absent (S2.8.4 asserts a fixed odd prime exists but not that it avoids every denominator in the finite table of factors so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors). The plan quotes the paper's derivation lines in the roles the paper gives them throughout, and no sub-step is stated contrary to the paper.
